page.layout: One printed page, single text column of dictionary entries with Hebrew and Aramaic script; running head at top centre; page number at top left. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: סַלְעָא Ch. Siclus, qui duplex, Sacer, ponderis dimidii Taleri imperialis : Communis qui quadrantem Taleri valuit. Plur. סַלְעִין, סַלְעִי.
סַלְעָם Pahel quadratæ formæ Chal. Absorbere, absumere, deglutire, decorare, perdere, disperdere. Ithpahal אִסְתַּלְעַם Absorberi, cósumi, perdi.
סַלַּף Hebr. Pervertit. Hinc Ithpeh. Ch. אִסְתַּלִּיף וּפוּמֵיהּ Et os ejus fuit distortum, Esth. 6.10. in T. sec.

סַלַּק Ch. & Syr. Ascendere, conscendere: Item Cessare, definere, finem habere, finiri. Pahel סַלֵּק Ascendere facere, tollere, auferre, transferre, subducere. Ithpahel אִסְתַּלֵּק Efferri, elevari, assumi, tolli, auferri, subduci, subducere se, discedere, recedere.
סוּלְתָּא, סוּלְתָּא Ch. Simila, Similago, Farina purissima. Hebr. סוֹלֶת.
סַמָּא Ch. Caecum esse vel fieri. Fut. Syr. Cœci fiant, Joh. 9.39. Pah. סַמֵּי Cæcū facere, excæcare. Sic Syr. 1. Joh. 2.11. Ithpeh. Fut. עַד לָא יִסְתַּמּוּן Antequam cæci fiant, Eccles. 12.2.
סַמֵּי, סַמָּיָא, סַמְיָא Ch. & Syr. Cæcus. Pl. סַמָּיִן, סַמֵּי, Syr. Cæci.
סַמְבָּא & סַמְבְּטִיון Ch. Sabbatjon, Fluvius Sabbathicus, de quo Vide Eliam in Thisbi, Fullerum

page.notes: Hebrew and Aramaic script is transcribed approximately; vocalisation and Syriac forms may be imperfect. Marginal faint show-through from the reverse page omitted.
